_about: Part 2 (world2 WP-H1) Kling art. model kling-image-v3_0_omni, 2k. Processing: bg/worldmap2 height 1080 then bottom cut >= 7% (watermark + flat band), WebP q80; cg height 1080 then bottom cut 7.5%, q82; portraits height 1024 then bottom cut 5.5%, q82; tex centre square -> 512 -> seamless_lib.make_seamless, q82. Quality lowered in steps of 2 only when a file exceeded the spec size budget (bg 180 KB, cg 170 KB, portrait 90 KB, tex 60 KB). "assets" lists accepted files, "generations" lists every Kling job (including rejected retries) with its prompt and generation id.
